_doc: FEAT-005 item 5 — brand config. Cities = config, not clones. The app resolves the active brand (see _resolveBrand in app-core.js) by, in order: ?city=<id> override (persisted to ds_city) > first URL path segment (path-based deploy, e.g. /lucknow/) > matching 'host' (subdomain deploy). 'default' MUST mirror today's Donnibo look so the base path/host is a no-op. Add a city = one entry under 'cities' keyed by its brandId — no code copy.
